verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a dependency-free C/C++ inference engine that runs models locally on Apple silicon, x86 CPUs and NVIDIA/AMD GPUs, with quantization and CPU+GPU hybrid offload to fit large models on personal hardware. Community reports confirm hands-on local runs on M1 Macs, desktop i7s and laptops, including self-hosted vision use. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of offline/no-telemetry operation guaranteeing prompts never leave the device (the -hf flow downloads models from Hugging Face, though inference itself is local).
